name: ta86_3xperiment0
description: 3xperiment0 Chaos, Art, Light Experiments 3xperiment0 is an experimental and evolving LoRA focused on artistic chaos and expressive lighting behavior. It is designed for moments where an image already feels good, but something subtle or unexpected is still missing. This LoRA introduces small shifts in lighting, contrast and visual balance that can push an image into a more artistic and emotionally charged direction. You can try (nearly) any style you want. It works especially well for art driven styles, but also blends nicely into anime, semi realistic and even photorealistic compositions. Rather than enforcing a strict look, 3xperiment0 acts as a creative catalyst, nudging the image toward more interesting light interactions and visual tension. This LoRA is currently in absolute beta and still under active development. Results can vary depending on prompt structure and model combination. Some effects remain subtle, others may feel more experimental by design. Known limitations (for flux) at the moment are hands and feet, especially fingers and toes, which may require additional guidance or cleanup. Krea 2: Recommended starting strength is 0.5 to 1.2 Maximum recommended strength is around 2.0 Zit/Flux: Recommended starting strength is 0.3 to 0.5 Maximum recommended strength is 1.2 From around 0.8 and above, lighting behavior may noticeably shift or drift in unexpected ways Anything you find of mine outside of Civitai is shared without my permission.
